programmes.evidence: Official engineering doctoral school explicitly lists GI Industrial engineering: conception and production among its PhD specialities. Current university PhD admission page identifies this engineering school as a path to the national PhD diploma; its own enrolment page confirms current doctoral admission.
limitations: English specialty page has a visible leading G typo; no separate Engineering Production PhD award is inferred.

branches.conclusion: Official Doctoral School of Management Sciences is a broad business/gestion school. Its five listed specialties are Finance, Human Resources, Strategic Management, Marketing and Information Systems–Supply Chain Management; none is formally named Operations, quantitative Management Science or Industrial Engineering. Broad school name alone is not accepted as a quantitative Management Science title.

Official I-MEP² doctoral school names five PhD specialty domains, including GI Industrial engineering: conception and production. This is the one title-eligible engineering specialty evidenced, while mechanics, materials, electrochemistry and process fields are distinct.
MSTII formal PhD specialty inventory lists Computer Science, Mathematics-Informatics, Applied Mathematics, Mathematics, with no named Operations Research specialty.
